tooltipsimproved.config.title: Tooltips Improved
tooltipsimproved.config.foldTrims.toolti: Show an armor trim on one line, like "Sentry Armor Trim (Iron)". Hold Shift to see the full lines.
tooltipsimproved.config.wrap.tooltip: How to break tooltip lines that are too wide.
tooltipsimproved.config.wrapWidth.toolti: Widest a line may be, in pixels, when Wrap Text is Fixed Width.
tooltipsimproved.config.unwrapButtonTool: Skip vanilla's narrow wrap on button tooltips, so they follow Wrap Text too.
tooltipsimproved.config.placement.toolti: Where to put a tooltip that doesn't fit on either side of the cursor.
tooltipsimproved.config.placeAllTooltips: Apply placement to every tooltip, not just ones that follow the cursor.
tooltipsimproved.config.topFirst.tooltip: Keep the top of a tooltip taller than the screen in view, instead of the bottom.
tooltipsimproved.config.buttonTooltipsBe: Show button tooltips centered under the button (or above it) instead of at the cursor.
tooltipsimproved.config.backgroundOpacit: Opacity of the tooltip background and border. Text stays solid.
tooltipsimproved.config.removeFirstLineG: Remove the small gap under a tooltip's first line.
tooltipsimproved.config.scrollWheel.tool: Move tooltips with the mouse wheel or a trackpad. Hold the sideways key (Left Alt) to move them left and right.
Put a tooltip back in place once it's no longer shown.
tooltipsimproved.config.invertHorizontal: Flip which way the wheel moves tooltips sideways.
tooltipsimproved.config.invertVertical.t: Flip which way the wheel moves tooltips up and down.
tooltipsimproved.config.wheelStep.toolti: Pixels a tooltip moves per wheel notch.
tooltipsimproved.config.smoothness.toolt: How quickly a tooltip glides to its new position. 100% moves it instantly.
tooltipsimproved.config.movementKeys.too: Also move tooltips with your movement keys (WASD by default). Ignored while typing in a text field.
tooltipsimproved.config.keySpeed.tooltip: Pixels per second a tooltip moves while a move key is held.
